size_feedback.request: Copy glyph itself is too large on both platforms
size_feedback.android: 16dp compact size selected for this independent preview after feedback. Official nbm0.D supports16/24, confirmed against smali. Effective Remote parent override remains unresolved.
size_feedback.ios: All repaired copy entries use the existing scaled14pt host metric. RemoteCodeBlockPreview previously rendered the raw original asset with no size constraint. Exact official code-header metric remains unresolved.

code_header_feedback.finding: Android NativeCodeBlock placed the action as a separate leading child and left the public code block at intrinsic width. Official sqi.a uses a full-width container and trailing header actions.

android_source.layout: 52dp header; start16/end8; weighted language then action row; full-width code container

code_header_feedback.implementation: Restore header row, language label and trailing copy, shared full-width surface; retain public renderer horizontal scrolling and exact code payload. Background token and default renderer body style remain host adaptations.
code_header_feedback.ios: NativeMessageBlock already anchors code action at trailing16/top4; RemoteCodeBlockPreview uses language/Spacer/copy header. This feedback requires no new position override on iOS.

response_copy_visibility.finding: Both independent Remote renderers displayed whole-response copy whenever text was nonempty, including streaming partial text.
response_copy_visibility.implementation: Expose whole-response copy only for nonempty completed turns. Retain per-code-block copy. A new request/turn derives its own visibility.
response_copy_visibility.basis: User correction and independent frontend phase contract. Android pkm.g checks hideInlineActions (ycc0.t1 serialized index120 in ucc0); mapping of official upstream generation state to this field is unresolved.
